insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (varies as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Restore Benefit (Reset Benefit) — unlimited triggers, includes same illness
great.quote: We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, for any illness/disease/injury for the Insured Person in a Policy Year... i. This benefit will be triggered unlimited times for any illness/disease/injury.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 11. Reset Benefit
great.explanation: Your Sum Insured can be replenished multiple times in the same policy year once the available SI is insufficient due to prior claims (subject to conditions like not for the first claim of the year). This is stronger than many standard restores.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization cover — 90 days
great.quote: We will cover the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... immediately 90 days before the Insured Person’s Admission to Hospital
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 4. Pre-Hospitalisation Medical Expenses
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days before admission (higher than common 30/60 days).

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (Loyalty Bonus) — does not reduce on claim
great.quote: We will provide a Loyalty Bonus of 20%... at the end of each Policy Year irrespective of a claim being initiated... ix. In the event of Claim, under the Policy during any subsequent Policy Year, the credited Loyalty Bonus will not be reduced.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 10. Loyalty Bonus
great.explanation: Bonus SI is added at renewal even if you claim, and it is not reduced due to claims. This is better than typical NCBs that reset on claim.

great.name: Bariatric surgery covered (subject to conditions)
great.quote: We will cover medical expenses incurred in respect of Hospitalisation of the Insured Person for Surgical Procedure/treatment for Obesity up to Annual Sum Insured
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 12. Bariatric Surgery Cover
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered (with eligibility criteria and waiting period), which is a strong benefit not present in many base plans.

good.name: Room rent — capped at Single Private AC room (base)
good.quote: Room Rent charges up to Single Private AC room;
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 1. In-patient Treatment
good.explanation: Base plan room eligibility is Single Private AC room, which is standard/good (not 'any room'). Note: an optional 'Room Modifier' can upgrade/modify room eligibility.

good.name: PED waiting period — 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code- Excl01
good.explanation: PED waiting of 36 months is within the acceptable standard range (2–4 years) per market practice.

good.name: Specific illness waiting period — 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 2. Specified Disease/Procedure Waiting Period - Code- Excl02
good.explanation: 24 months for specified diseases/procedures is standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period — 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 4. 30-day waiting period - Code- Excl03
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard across health insurance (accidents covered).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover — 180 days
good.quote: We will cover the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... immediately 180 days following the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 5. Post Hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Covers eligible expenses for 180 days after discharge (good/standard upper end).

good.name: Air Ambulance covered (Domestic) — optional cover
good.quote: We will cover the expenses incurred on Air Ambulance services up to the Annual Sum Insured...
good.reference: Add ons/Optional Covers > 12. Domestic Air Ambulance Cover
good.explanation: Air ambulance is available as an optional cover (any limit coverage is considered a useful add-on).

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with disease exclusions)
good.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the Domiciliary Hospitalization of the Insured Person during the Policy Period up to the Annual Sum Insured
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 9. Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home hospitalization is covered if criteria are met (but note the listed ailment exclusions under this section).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (non-medical items list excluded) — out-of-pocket unless Claim Protector add-on
bad.quote: medicines, drugs and consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non-medical) in Annexure II.
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 1. In-patient Treatment (point v) + Annexure II
bad.explanation: Many common hospital 'consumables/non-medical' items are excluded as per Annexure II (e.g., gloves, masks, nebulisation kit etc.), leading to out-of-pocket costs unless you opt for Optional Cover 'Claim Protector' which makes certain non-payables payable for an admissible claim.

bad.name: Proportionate deduction due to room rent limit (Single Private AC) — can reduce payout if you choose higher room
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is specified... then the Insured Person shall bear a proportional share of the total Associated medical expenses
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 1. In-patient Treatment (claim conditions)
bad.explanation: Because room rent is capped (Single Private AC), choosing a higher room can trigger proportionate deductions on associated medical expenses, reducing claim payout.

bad.name: Modern treatments list appears limited / not clearly 'no sub-limits'
bad.quote: We will cover... Technological Advancements and Treatments... for the below mentioned... [listed items: Robotic surgeries, Deep Brain stimulation, etc.]
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 3. Technological Advancements and Treatments
bad.explanation: Coverage for modern treatments is provided as a specific list rather than an open-ended 'all modern treatments without sub-limits'. Anything not in the list may not be covered under this head (verify in full wording/benefit schedule).

unclear.name: Co-pay (base policy) not explicitly stated (only voluntary co-pay / optional network advantage co-pay mentioned)
unclear.quote: “Co-Payment” shall mean a cost sharing requirement... A co-payment does not reduce the Sum Insured
unclear.reference: Definitions > Co-Payment (definition only); Optional Covers > 19. Voluntary Co-Payment; Optional Cover 29 Network Advantage (20% co-pay outside PPN if opted)
unclear.explanation: The document defines co-pay and offers optional co-pay structures, but it does not clearly state whether the base plan has a mandatory co-pay by default (e.g., for senior ages). Confirm from policy schedule/benefit table whether any mandatory co-pay applies.
